item.title: Homework (graded)
item.description: Homework (graded) Submission via pull request in the private portfolio repository by 08.11.2026. Effort: approx. 2 hours, 3 hours at most. The homework is discussed in session 3. Scenario The Musterstadt Secondary School (800 students, 70 teachers, known from session 1) is getting an extension with three floors: Ground floor: library, assembly hall, 2 computer labs (30 fixed PCs each) 1st floor: 9 classrooms 2nd floor: 9 classrooms, 1 staff room The old building (administration, servers, internet connection) is 40 m away and can be reached through an empty conduit. So far there is one router with a single flat network 192.168.0.0/24 and a WLAN with one shared password for everyone. The school management demands: reliable WLAN in every classroom, separate networks for administration, teachers, students and guests, and a network that will still be sufficient in five years. IT is looked after by a teacher team (two people).
